text: Databases help us store and organize information. The most common type is the relational database, where data lives in tables with rows and columns. To get information, we write queries, usually in a language called SQL. NoSQL databases work differently: they store data in flexible forms like documents or key-value pairs, which is useful for large or changing data. Before building a database, we design a data model to plan how data connects. We also add indexes, which speed up searches. Choosing between SQL and NoSQL depends on your needs.
